review.notes: Full review of the same head the previous review read. The 15 sampled targets were checked at their locators in ribet94, buzzard00, edixhoven92, kw2, kisin09 and ribet-stein (43 locators); Gross 12.8-12.9, Diamond Lemma 2.2 and Theorem 1.1, and Kisin's p>2 standing assumption were not readable or not opened and are listed as not verifiable. Numeric Checks recomputed (11a1 at 7 and 29, Delta*E4^2*E6 mod 107, 141a1 discriminant, E4 trace Check, degeneracy matrices, nodal congruence module). Suggested.lean elaborates with four sorry warnings only; the four headlines match Ribet (1.3), (1.5), (2.1), (2.2); no padding. Dependency check: 0 problems, no UPWARD or CYCLE. All automatic checks pass; two citation-resolver leads set aside as false positives. 47 cross-roadmap ids resolved on main; five open heads read. Six small corrections (three carried from the previous review, three new: the consumer sentence against SerreModularityByCompatibleSystems S6, the label of the auxiliary place in 6.10, three undeclared supplier names) and one format note; none blocking. One licence question for the human reviewers (the Gross scan).
